metadata.description: A heads-up display for Claude Code: plan limits and context at a glance, no network requests.

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: A heads-up display above the Claude Code prompt. For now: your Claude plan's 5 hour and weekly limits, and the context window, as battery gauges, reset times, the rate you're using them at, one-click Compact and per-chat Auto compact. Makes no network requests of its own.
